title: SAFETY SUBSPACES ARE NOT LINEARLY DISTINCT: A FINE-TUNING CASE STUDY
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and geometric properties of safety alignment in LLMs, specifically investigating whether safety-relevant behaviors reside in distinct linear subspaces of model weights or activations. While safety alignment itself is intended to make models 'aligned with human values,' the paper's study is a mechanistic exploration of entanglement between safety and utility rather than an evaluation of religion, morals, or specific ethical reasoning frameworks.
